summary: Regression pass after ChemiVerse visual redesign (neon lab-green + magenta + amber theme, 3D lab hero with glowing flasks, global 3D particle background). All 10 pages load with 0 JS errors and 0 console errors. Multiple WebGL canvases coexist safely (2 canvases on 3D pages, 1 on non-3D pages) — no 'too many WebGL contexts' warnings. Every interactive flow verified end-to-end and still working: navbar routing, hero CTAs, module grid (8 cards), Periodic Galaxy (118 elements + search dim + category filter + element click nav), Element Profile prev/next, Atom Viewer picker + slider, Molecule Viewer switch, Reaction Simulator run+reset, Virtual Lab NaOH+phenolphthalein correct pink observation, Quiz full 8-question run awarding XP to backend (Dashboard shows 20 XP after run), AI Tutor SSE streaming with markdown rendered (bold + blockquote now visible — iteration_1 design issue is fixed). Only harmless warning: THREE.Clock deprecation notice from drei.

issues: Wireframe molecule shapes in SceneBackground occasionally overlap the module cards on Home / Dashboard cards, faintly visible through the glass panels. Not blocking — the 3D bg is placed behind (chem-bg + scene-bg z-index looks correct) but the wireframes at z=-1..-5 can peek through translucent cards. Purely aesthetic.

Hero heading 'INTERACTIVE 3D CHEMISTRY LAB' badge uses --cyan token but committed theme is neon lab-green + magenta + amber; verify the CSS variable --cyan is remapped to green (visually it appears green in screenshot — good). Not a bug, just noting the legacy variable name.

action_items: NONE blocking. Optional: rename the CSS variable --cyan to --lab-green in index.css since the committed theme dropped cyan — would improve code clarity but has no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: SceneBackground mounts a persistent Canvas outside the router — good, prevents context re-creation on nav.
Home.jsx correctly uses Suspense + no zoom/pan on OrbitControls, keeping the hero interactive but non-disruptive.
LabScene.jsx builds LatheGeometry with useMemo keyed on type/fill — efficient and no memory leak observed.

Two WebGL canvases per 3D page (global bg + per-page 3D). Browsers cap ~16 contexts; only 2 here so safe, but if more per-page canvases are added later, consider drei's <View> multiplexing to keep a single context.
PeriodicGalaxy uses opacity dimming for search/filter — this keeps DOM stable but tests must check opacity, not element count. Documented in context_for_next_testing_agent.
AITutor now renders markdown correctly (react-markdown or similar was added — iteration_1 design issue resolved).
No files >700 lines; component sizes remain healthy.
seed_data_creation: None new. Quiz run auto-created a TEST-adjacent progress row for the current browser session (20 XP after 2/8 quiz).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids: Periodic uses element-{SYMBOL} (not number) + filter-{category}, search 'element-search'. Filter/search DIMS (opacity 0.15) — do NOT count children; check getComputedStyle(el).opacity. ElementProfile uses prev-element / next-element. Atom Viewer: atom-pick-{symbol} + atom-slider. Molecule: molecule-select-{id}. Reaction: reaction-select-{id} + run-reaction + reset-reaction + reaction-equation. VirtualLab: reagent-{id} + mix-button + lab-reset + lab-observation. Quiz: quiz-question + quiz-option-{0-3} (auto-advance ~900ms so wait >=1500ms) + quiz-score + quiz-restart. AI Tutor: chat-input + chat-send + chat-msg-user/assistant + chat-suggestion. Home: hero-cta-primary/secondary + module-card-{id} + cta-band-btn. THREE.Clock deprecation warning is harmless — from drei, not app code.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Redesign regression is clean; all interactive flows and 3D scenes work with the new neon-green committed theme. AI Tutor markdown design issue from iteration_1 was already resolved by main agent.
